name: google-form-automation
description: An assistant for Daily Check-in, Daily Status, and Leave Application Google Forms

scripts.build:linux: npm run build && playwright install chromium --no-shell && electron-builder --config desktop/build.config.cjs --linux deb --publish never
scripts.build:windows: npm run build && playwright install chromium --no-shell && electron-builder --config desktop/build.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
